causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: The price was much higher than forecast largely as a result of network congestion.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: From early in the day network equipment in the Energy Australia network supplying the Sydney Central Business District (CBD) was out of service for planned maintenance.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: At 10.25 am the Kemps Creek to Sydney South 330 kV transmission line was taken out of service by TransGrid to remedy the potential overloads on the 330 kV cables for the remainder of the day.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: This altered flows on the remainder of the transmission network and flows exceeded allowable limits on the Mount Piper to Wallerawang 330 kV lines for three dispatch intervals (10.30 am to 10.40 am inclusive).

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: In response to the high prices there appeared to be a 540 MW reduction in New South Wales demand at around 11 am and a number of New South Wales generators rebid into negative prices.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At the same time New South Wales generators also rebid into higher prices.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The increase in demand combined with a reduction in low-priced capacity set the dispatch price close to the cap for four dispatch intervals from 11.30 am.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 9.31 am, effective from 9.40 am, Delta Electricity rebid the ramp rates of Mount Piper units one and two. The 'ramp down rate' on each unit was reduced from 5 MW/min down to the minimum allowable level of 3 MW/min.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 10.31 am, effective from 10.40 am, Snowy Hydro rebid the ramp rate of Tumut three from 200 MW/min down to the minimum allowable level of 3 MW/min.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 10.32 am, effective from 10.40 am, Macquarie Generation rebid the ramp rates across its Bayswater units. The ramp down rate was reduced from 4 MW/min down to the minimum allowable level of 3 MW/min for each unit.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At 9.43 am, effective for the 10.30 am trading interval, Delta Electricity reduced the available capacity of Wallerawang unit seven by 280 MW (a majority of this capacity was priced below $90/MWh).

constraints_named.quote: As has been the case in the New South Wales region several times over the 2009/10 summer, the "system normal" constraint N>>N-NIL__S was a factor in the high price event.
The system normal constraint N>>N-NIL__S bound for most of the time from the dispatch interval ending 9.10 am to the dispatch interval ending at 12.30 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: Although the import limit across the QNI interconnector was forecast to be around 1050 MW into New South Wales for most of the day, from around 10 am the impact of the binding N>>N-NIL__S constraint forced flow into Queensland, by up to 446 MW.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: Although the import limit across the Vic-NSW interconnector into New South Wales was forecast to be up to 1135 MW four hours ahead, the impact of the binding N>>N-NIL__S constraint forced flow into Victoria by up to 1301 MW at 12.30 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: The capability of the Terranora interconnector was close to forecast.

intervals.quote: On Thursday 4 February 2010, the spot price in New South Wales reached $5541/MWh for the 12 pm trading interval.

network_outages.quote: From early in the day network equipment in the Energy Australia network supplying the Sydney Central Business District (CBD) was out of service for planned maintenance.

peak_price.quote: On Thursday 4 February 2010, the spot price in New South Wales reached $5541/MWh for the 12 pm trading interval.

rebid_set_price.quote: At the same time New South Wales generators also rebid into higher prices. The increase in demand combined with a reduction in low-priced capacity set the dispatch price close to the cap for four dispatch intervals from 11.30 am.
